bank_connections_secret_check.name: bank_connections_secret_check
bank_connections_secret_check.value: ("bank_connections"."session_id" is null or char_length("bank_connections"."session_id") between 1 and 100) and ("bank_connections"."state_hash" is null or "bank_connections"."state_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

bank_links_fields_check.name: bank_links_fields_check
bank_links_fields_check.value: char_length("bank_links"."account_uid") between 1 and 100 and ("bank_links"."iban" is null or char_length("bank_links"."iban") between 5 and 34) and "bank_links"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' and char_length("bank_links"."name") between 1 and 100

user_settings_savings_check.name: user_settings_savings_check
user_settings_savings_check.value: (savings_goal is null or savings_goal > 0) and savings_start >= 0

user_settings_savings_anchor_check.name: user_settings_savings_anchor_check
user_settings_savings_anchor_check.value: (savings_anchor is null) = (savings_anchor_date is null) and (savings_anchor is null or savings_anchor >= 0)

user_settings_btw_check.name: user_settings_btw_check
user_settings_btw_check.value: (btw_client is null or char_length(btw_client) between 1 and 60) and (btw_pocket is null or char_length(btw_pocket) between 1 and 60)

user_settings_income_tax_pocket_check.name: user_settings_income_tax_pocket_check
user_settings_income_tax_pocket_check.value: income_tax_pocket is null or char_length(income_tax_pocket) between 1 and 60
